annotations.title: Institutional buying and selling by quarter

description: Returns what institutional managers did with the tracked AI and semiconductor stocks in one quarter, from their SEC Form 13F filings: the net flow of managers present at both quarters (stock pickers apart from index funds, market makers and wealth platforms), by segment; the companies most bought and sold; the largest moves of named managers; new big positions; positions sold in full; and whose declared picks returned most. Default: the latest quarter whose 13F deadline (45 days after quarter end) has passed; a quarter still being filed returns its first filers (`wave`). Use it when the user asks what hedge funds or institutions bought or sold in a quarter. A 13F shows long positions at quarter end, filed up to 45 days later — not current holdings; `method` in the answer says how flows are counted. For one fund or person, use get_holders; for one company's shareholders, use get_ownership.
name: get_fund_flows
